title: POST /api/projects — create a project
description: Create a new project for the authenticated user. Validate input, insert record, and optionally seed milestone templates for software projects.
acceptanceCriteria: Accepts { name, description?, type, milestoneTemplates?: string[] }
Returns 400 if name is empty or type is invalid
Returns 201 with the created project object
If milestoneTemplates provided, inserts them as milestones with sort_order

steps.details: Create server/src/validators/projects.ts. Define createProjectSchema = z.object({ name: z.string().min(1).max(255), description: z.string().max(5000).optional(), type: z.enum(['software','design','physical','content','learning','other']), milestoneTemplates: z.array(z.string().max(255)).max(10).optional() }).

steps.description: Create projects router and POST / handler
steps.details: Create server/src/routes/projects.ts. POST /: 1) Validate body. 2) Insert into projects table with user_id = req.userId, name, description, type, status='active'. 3) If milestoneTemplates provided, insert each as a milestone with sort_order = index. 4) Log a timeline event: status_change with payload { from: null, to: 'active' }. 5) Return 201 with project.
In index.ts, apply requireAuth middleware and mount: app.use('/api/projects', requireAuth, projectsRouter).

POST /api/projects with valid body and auth token — expect 201 with project. Try without auth — expect 401. Try with empty name — expect 400. Try with 5 milestone templates — verify 5 milestone rows created.

technicalNotes: Use a database transaction when inserting project + milestones to ensure atomicity
sort_order for templates should be 0, 1, 2... in the order they're provided
